description: This Java class 'AuthenticationResultWaiter' is designed to wait for a future holding an AuthenticationResult, and to handle timeouts by throwing a specific exception. It encapsulates asynchronous waiting logic with timeout handling for authentication results.

classes.name: AuthenticationResultWaiter
classes.description: A thread-safe class implementing Supplier that waits for an AuthenticationResult future, with a timeout that results in a specific exception if exceeded.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of AuthenticationResultWaiter with a given future and headers, using a default timeout.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a CompletableFuture that completes when the authentication result is available or throws exception after timeout.

methods.name: mapException
methods.description: Maps a Throwable cause into a GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException with context headers.
